providers.local.title: Local models
providers.local.offline_help: Run entirely on your computer. Your audio stays on this device.
providers.local.text_help: Cleanup, summaries and questions use the language model selected under Models. That model may run on a server.
providers.local.benchmark_help: Independent benchmark scores: speed on Apple Silicon and accuracy in the selected language. Higher is better.
providers.local.unload_help: The model loads for your first dictation and is removed from memory after being idle.

credentials.migration_required: Approve access to your saved credentials once to keep Pennel connected after updates. macOS may ask once for each saved item.
